+module: icx_logging

+short_description: Manage logging on Ruckus ICX switches
+description:
+  - Manage syslog hosts, console, buffered, persistence, RFC5424, and global logging.
+options:
+  dest:
+    description: Logging destination or setting.
+    type: str
+    choices: [host, console, buffered, persistence, rfc5424, on]
+  name:
+    description: Host name or IP address for a syslog destination.

+    dest: host
+    name: 2001:db8::1
+    udp_port: 514
+
+- name: Disable buffered debugging
+  icx_logging:
+    dest: buffered
+    level: debugging
+    state: absent

+- name: Set facility and hosts
+  icx_logging:
+    aggregate:
+      - {facility: local7}

+      - {dest: host, name: '2001:db8::1', udp_port: 514}

+commands:
+  description: Configuration commands sent to the device.
+  returned: always
+  type: list

+            current = next((x for x in have if x['dest'] == 'facility'), None)

+            elif state == 'absent' and current and current.get('explicit') and (facility is None or facility == current_name):

+        if dest == 'host':

+                if not exact:
+                    for old in matching:
+                        commands.append(_host_command(old, absent=True))
+                    commands.append(_host_command(entry))
+            else:
+                for old in (exact if entry.get('udp_port') is not None else matching):
+                    commands.append(_host_command(old, absent=True))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = matching[0]['level'] if matching else set()
+            levels = entry['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, current)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in adds:
+                        commands.append('logging buffered ' + level)
+            else:
+                _, removes = diff_in_list(current - levels, current)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in removes:
+                        commands.append('no logging buffered ' + level)
+        else:

+            if dest == 'console' and entry.get('level'):
+                prefix += ' ' + entry['level']
+            present = bool(matching)
+            if dest == 'console' and state == 'present' and entry.get('level'):
+                present = any(x.get('level') == entry['level'] for x in matching)
+            if state == 'present' and not present:
+                commands.append(prefix)
+            elif state == 'absent' and present:

+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+

+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

+            dict(facility='local7'),
+            dict(dest='host', name='192.0.2.1', udp_port=514),
+            dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', udp_port=5514)]))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[

+            'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514'])
+
+    def test_remove_ipv6_host_with_discovered_port(self):
+        self.config = 'logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='host', name='2001:db8::1', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=[
+            'no logging host ipv6 2001:db8::1 udp-port 5514'])
+
+    def test_buffered_levels_and_idempotency(self):
+        self.config = 'logging buffered\nno logging buffered debugging\n'
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['logging buffered debugging'])
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='warnings', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=True, commands=['no logging buffered warnings'])
+        set_module_args(dict(dest='buffered', level='debugging', state='absent'))
+        self.execute_module(changed=False, commands=[])

+        set_module_args(dict(aggregate=[

+            entry['udp_port'] = None
+        else:
+            entry['name'] = entry['name'].strip()
+            try:
+                entry['addr6'] = ip_address(entry['name']).version == 6
+            except ValueError:
+                if ':' in entry['name']:
+                    module.fail_json(msg='invalid IPv6 address: %s' % entry['name'])
+                entry['addr6'] = False
+            if entry['udp_port'] is not None:
+                if not 1 <= int(entry['udp_port']) <= 65535:
+                    module.fail_json(msg='udp_port must be between 1 and 65535')
+                entry['udp_port'] = str(entry['udp_port'])
+        if dest == 'buffered':
+            levels = entry['level']
+            if isinstance(levels, (list, tuple, set)):
+                levels = set(levels)
+            else:
+                levels = {levels}
+            if not levels or not levels.issubset(set(LEVELS)):
+                module.fail_json(msg='level must be one of %s' % ', '.join(LEVELS))
+            entry['level'] = levels
+        elif entry['level'] is not None and entry['level'] not in LEVELS:
+            module.fail_json(msg='level must be one of %s' % ', '.join(LEVELS))
+        result.append(entry)
+    return result
+
+
+def map_config_to_obj(module):
+    data = get_config(module, flags='| include logging',
+                      compare=module.params.get('check_running_config'))
+    obj = []
+    facility = 'user'
+    facility_explicit = False
+    enabled_buffer = set()
+    disabled_buffer = set()
+    buffer_seen = False
+    logging_off = False
+    for raw in data.splitlines():
+        line = raw.strip()
+        if line == 'no logging on':
+            logging_off = True
+        elif line == 'no logging facility':
+            facility = 'user'
+            facility_explicit = False
+        elif line.startswith('logging facility '):
+            facility = line.split()[2]
+            facility_explicit = True
+        elif line.startswith('logging host '):
+            obj.append(dict(dest='host', name=parse_name(line, 'host'),
+                            udp_port=parse_port(line, 'host'),
+                            addr6=parse_address(line, 'host'), level=None, facility=None))
+        elif line == 'logging console' or line.startswith('logging console '):
+            parts = line.split()
+            obj.append(dict(dest='console', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            level=parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else None, facility=None))
+        elif line == 'logging persistence':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='persistence', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            level=None, facility=None))
+        elif line == 'logging enable rfc5424':
+            obj.append(dict(dest='rfc5424', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                            level=None, facility=None))
+        elif line == 'logging buffered':
+            buffer_seen = True
+            enabled_buffer.update(LEVELS)
+        elif line.startswith('logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[2]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffer_seen = True
+                enabled_buffer.add(level)
+        elif line.startswith('no logging buffered '):
+            level = line.split()[3]
+            if level in LEVELS:
+                buffer_seen = True
+                disabled_buffer.add(level)
+        elif line == 'no logging buffered':
+            buffer_seen = False
+            enabled_buffer.clear()
+            disabled_buffer.clear()
+    if buffer_seen:
+        # A bare enable line enables all levels; explicit negative lines override it.
+        obj.append(dict(dest='buffered', name=None, udp_port=None,
+                        level=enabled_buffer - disabled_buffer, facility=None))
+    obj.append(dict(dest='facility', name=None, udp_port=None, level=None,
+                    facility=facility, explicit=facility_explicit))
+    if not logging_off:
+        obj.append(dict(dest='on', name=None, udp_port=None, level=None, facility=None))
+    return obj
+
+
+def _host_command(obj, absent=False):
+    command = ('no logging host ' if absent else 'logging host ')
+    if obj.get('addr6'):
+        command += 'ipv6 '
+    command += obj['name']
+    if obj.get('udp_port') is not None:
+        command += ' udp-port ' + str(obj['udp_port'])
+    return command
+
+
+def map_obj_to_commands(updates):
+    want, have = updates
+    commands = []
+    for entry in want:
+        dest = entry['dest']
+        state = entry['state']
+        facility = entry.get('facility')
+        if facility is not None or dest == 'facility':
+            current = next((x for x in have if x['dest'] == 'facility'), None)
+            current_name = current['facility'] if current else 'user'
+            if state == 'present' and facility is not None and facility != current_name:
+                commands.append('logging facility ' + facility)
+            elif state == 'absent' and current and current.get('explicit') and (facility is None or facility == current_name):
+                commands.append('no logging facility')
+        if dest is None or dest == 'facility':
+            continue
+        matching = [x for x in have if x['dest'] == dest]
+        if dest == 'host':
+            matching = [x for x in matching if x['name'] == entry['name'] and
+                        x.get('addr6', False) == entry.get('addr6', False)]
+            exact = [x for x in matching if x.get('udp_port') == entry.get('udp_port')]
+            if state == 'present':
+                if not exact:
+                    for old in matching:
+                        commands.append(_host_command(old, absent=True))
+                    commands.append(_host_command(entry))
+            else:
+                for old in (exact if entry.get('udp_port') is not None else matching):
+                    commands.append(_host_command(old, absent=True))
+        elif dest == 'buffered':
+            current = matching[0]['level'] if matching else set()
+            levels = entry['level']
+            if state == 'present':
+                adds, _ = diff_in_list(levels, current)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in adds:
+                        commands.append('logging buffered ' + level)
+            else:
+                _, removes = diff_in_list(current - levels, current)
+                for level in LEVELS:
+                    if level in removes:
+                        commands.append('no logging buffered ' + level)
+        else:
+            prefix = {'rfc5424': 'logging enable rfc5424'}.get(dest, 'logging ' + dest)
+            if dest == 'console' and entry.get('level'):
+                prefix += ' ' + entry['level']
+            present = bool(matching)
+            if dest == 'console' and state == 'present' and entry.get('level'):
+                present = any(x.get('level') == entry['level'] for x in matching)
+            if state == 'present' and not present:
+                commands.append(prefix)
+            elif state == 'absent' and present:
+                commands.append('no logging enable rfc5424' if dest == 'rfc5424' else 'no logging ' + dest)
+    return list(dict.fromkeys(commands))
+
+
+def main():
+    element_spec = dict(
+        dest=dict(type='str', choices=['host', 'console', 'buffered', 'persistence', 'rfc5424', 'on']),
+        name=dict(type='str'),
+        udp_port=dict(type='int'),
+        facility=dict(type='str'),
+        level=dict(type='raw'),
+        state=dict(type='str', default='present', choices=['present', 'absent']),
+        check_running_config=dict(type='bool', default=True,
+                                  fallback=(env_fallback, ['ANSIBLE_CHECK_ICX_RUNNING_CONFIG']))
+    )
+    aggregate_spec = deepcopy(element_spec)
+    remove_default_spec(aggregate_spec)
+    argument_spec = dict(aggregate=dict(type='list', elements='dict', options=aggregate_spec))
+    argument_spec.update(element_spec)
+    module = AnsibleModule(argument_spec=argument_spec, supports_check_mode=True)
+    if ip_address is None:
+        module.fail_json(msg='ipaddress python package is required')
+    want = map_params_to_obj(module, [('dest', 'host', ['name']),
+                                      ('dest', 'buffered', ['level'])])
+    have = map_config_to_obj(module)
+    commands = map_obj_to_commands((want, have))
+    if commands and not module.check_mode:
+        load_config(module, commands)
+    module.exit_json(changed=bool(commands), commands=commands)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()
